relevance_note: The paper reports a germline TNFAIP3 variant in one of its 7 children with SLE and lymphoproliferation, "a heterozygous c.559C>T (p. Q187X) mutation in the TNFAIP3 gene in patient 7", with individual-level detail (sex, variant, parental and grandparental testing).
method_note: Read the whole Markdown full text myself; no script transcribed any table. Only patient 7 (germline TNFAIP3 c.559C>T) is in scope: patients 1-4 carry a somatic NRAS variant, patient 6 a PIK3CD variant and patient 5 no mutation, so they and their relatives get no rows; the cohort size 7 is recorded in publications.cohort_size_as_stated. Patient 7's father is in scope because the paper states the TNFAIP3 mutation 'is from her father'; his variant row repeats the variant string printed for patient 7, which is the mutation the paper attributes to him. Patient 7's grandparents were screened by Sanger sequencing and were negative, but the paper gives neither their number nor their sex, so no rows were created for them (doing so would invent people). The bodies of Tables 1-3 are absent from this conversion (captions only), so their per-patient cells could not be read. Counts without names were not attributed to individuals ('renal (proteinuria and/or hematuria; 7/7 patients)', 'recurrent fever (6/7 patients)', 'cytopenia; 6/7 patients', 'only 2 patients presented with skin involvement'), while 'All patients had hepatomegaly and/or splenomegaly and/or lymphadenectasis', 'Antinuclear antibodies at a titer of >=1:320 were positive in all patients' and 'an increased IgE level was detected in the other patients' were treated as group statements that name the group and include patient 7. Contradiction: the variant is said to come from the father, yet 'The mutation was not identified in her grandparents'. No cell with stacked ' / ' values occurs in the text. is_proband is false because the paper never calls patient 7 a proband; boolean fields not stated are left null except is_proband.
